problem: Lack of integrated water, sanitation, and solid waste management systems in Vadodara, with particular neglect of faecal sludge and septage management (FSSM) undermining onsite sanitation sustainability and SDG 6 (Clean Water and Sanitation) targets
solution: 32 phased interventions across water, sanitation, and solid waste sectors designed to create an integrated system, including source augmentation, groundwater recharge, wastewater reuse, fecal sludge treatment, and waste-to-energy solutions
technology: Source augmentation (e.g., Ajwa reservoir), groundwater recharge systems, wastewater reuse infrastructure, fecal sludge treatment technologies (co-composting, cluster-based plants), waste-to-energy for bio-degradable waste, and SCADA for complaint redressal
outcome: Development of a resource-efficient plan addressing 3/13 SDG 3 targets and 6/10 SDG 6 targets, with integration to national frameworks (Swachh Survekshan, ODF cities) and international initiatives (100 Resilient Cities), and phased implementation with cost estimates
